description: Call this right after a Drint tool reported a plan limit and you gave the person its upgrade link. It waits (up to about 50 seconds) until they have paid and the space is on Pro, then answers: carry on at once with what they asked (call the tool again) without asking them. If it says they have not paid yet, tell them the link still works and call it again when they say so.
